about.title: About Promos 2022
paragraphs: Promos 2022 gathers the 4 promo cards from 4 products released in 2022: The Lost Art Promotion 2022 A, The Lost Art Promotion 2022 G, The Lost Art Promotion 2022 K and Yu-Gi-Oh! Championship Series 2022 prize card.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 4 cards, each in its main rarity) or the Master set (all 5, adding the 1 other rarity).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details and images come from YGOPRODeck, and prices from TCGplayer.
